features.name: Three side-by-side scenarios
features.description: Compares vendor full service, a hybrid two-step path, and in-house direct-to-OnBase scanning at once, on the identical page volume and document profile.
features.notes: Scenarios A / B / C are always all calculated, even when only one is expanded for editing

features.name: Itemized line-item breakdown
features.description: Every scenario shows each cost line — scanning, prep, OCR, indexing, transport, project management — with quantity, unit, rate, and amount.
features.notes: Includes explicit $0 lines so departments see what they are NOT paying for

features.name: Lowest-cost recommendation banner
features.description: A green banner names the cheapest option and shows the dollar and percent savings versus the other two, plus weeks saved.
features.notes: Falls back to an amber banner when in-house is not the cheapest for that volume

features.name: Effective cost-per-page
features.description: Each scenario total is also expressed as an effective $/page so different-sized projects can be compared on a common basis.
features.notes: total divided by page count

features.name: Calendar duration estimate
features.description: Each scenario reports an estimated number of weeks, broken into procurement, scanning, gap, and OnBase phases.
features.notes: Directional only; clearly disclaimed on the report

features.name: Volume by boxes or page count
features.description: Enter banker's boxes x pages-per-box, or override with an exact total page count.
features.notes: Page override wins over boxes when filled

features.name: Per-document or per-bundle indexing
features.description: Choose how index units are counted — average pages per document, or pages per bundle when pages-per-document is unknown.
features.notes: A bundle is one set sharing the same keyword values, indexed once

features.name: Condition and indexing-depth drivers
features.description: Document condition (clean / average / complex) drives prep cost; indexing depth (basic / standard / deep) sets keyword count and indexing rates.
features.notes: Both feed vendor rates and in-house throughput

features.name: OCR, large-format, and destruction options
features.description: Toggle full-text OCR, enter large-format (blueprint/map) pages, and flag certified destruction of originals.
features.notes: OCR is $0 in OnBase/capture but per-page for vendors

features.name: Pick who performs each service
features.description: For pickup, prep, scanning, capture software, scanner equipment, OCR, indexing, QC, storage, box storage, and destruction, choose 3rd party or BU students.
features.notes: Each choice re-prices that line at the appropriate vendor or student rate

features.name: Two-step overhead modeled honestly
features.description: Because hybrid output lands outside OnBase, the tool always adds a second project, DRIP import, a rework factor, and lead supervision.
features.notes: Makes the hidden cost of the two-tier PaperVision practice visible

features.name: Student labor breakdown
features.description: Shows total student cost and hours, then the hours and pay per student for the chosen team size.
features.notes: Only shown for scenarios that use BU students (B and C)

features.name: Staffing sensitivity table
features.description: A 1-to-5-student table proves that adding students shortens the timeline and per-student load while the total barely moves.
features.notes: Recomputes each scenario at each staffing level

features.name: Budget check + best value
features.description: Enter a budget and the tool flags which scenarios fit, by how much, and recommends the best value within budget.
features.notes: Optional; appears on both the results and the report

features.name: Signed budgetary report
features.description: One click builds a BU-letterhead report: executive summary, comparison table, hybrid assignment, why-two-step-costs-more, line items, assumptions, sources, and a signature block.
features.notes: Includes a prominent 'reference estimate only' disclaimer

features.name: Print / Save as PDF
features.description: The report paginates into letter-size pages on screen and prints or saves to PDF with an auto-built, descriptive file name.
features.notes: File name derived from contact, department, preparer, date, and scenario

features.name: Editable rate table
features.description: Document Imaging & Services can edit every unit rate, wage, throughput, and planning factor behind a password gate; estimates recompute live.
features.notes: Items with no published market price are tagged 'assumption'

features.name: Preparer roster
features.description: Maintain the team members who prepare analyses; the report's Prepared By field is a dropdown of default-flagged preparers.
features.notes: Saved per browser; travels with the JSON export

features.name: Export / import config and rates
features.description: Export the full configuration (rates + preparers) as JSON to share between machines, or export rates as an Excel-editable CSV.
features.notes: Import accepts both JSON and CSV

features.name: Runs anywhere, offline
features.description: A single self-contained HTML file that works from a USB stick, a shared drive, a web server, or an embed — no install, no internet.
features.notes: Resilient localStorage with in-memory fallback when storage is blocked

features.name: QI standard layout migration
features.description: Move the project from Downloads to a C:\ QI project root with the standard folder structure.
features.notes: Registry family_notes flags migration pending
